name: 承認の詳細サイドパネル
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Correct image1, complete Japanese Lighthouse approval panel LH09-0041. Original image2 controls fine icon silhouettes/strokes/optical proportions. Preserve ALL existing Japanese wording, all sections, control counts, photos, positions and empty states.
Required changes:
1. Entire notice strip behind the lock/message/「公開する」MUST be pure WHITE #FFFFFF, matching the main panel. Remove its pale-gray/tinted fill. Preserve fine neutral top/bottom rules. All ordinary surfaces including comments/footer remain white.
2. Active tab「コメント」must be Meiryo REGULAR40014/24, same optical weight as「すべての活動」. Current active tab is bold. Keep its brand-gradient underline and active indication. Only main title「資料の確認」may be Bold70020/28; all other labels/body/buttons regular, no synthetic bold.
3. Parent breadcrumb chevron after「資料を準備する」must match source tiny thin stroke: about8px logical height,4px width,1px stroke, not a chunky symbol.
4. Time-table stopwatch glyph must match original tiny single top-button silhouette exactly, with source's small detail only; do not invent mirrored side knobs. Clock/stopwatch and hollow circular play glyph stay fine thin optical strokes, no solid play triangle.
Everything else remains exactly: three approval buttons and seven top utility glyphs; complete permission message/public action; three header lines; assignee photo/name/X/recent dropdown, empty-date dashed circle, dependencies/inherited link; two time rows with all Japanese actions; description/body/add-subtask button; two tabs/sort; empty comment field/photo; footer label/photo/white佐/dashed person/plus/filled bell/exit text. No removed or added content. No new panels, colors, app shell or watermark.
reviewNotes: 案内帯の白面化を確認し全体の日本語・操作数・空状態を再点検。コメントタブはなお指定Regularより重く、シェブロンとストップウォッチの微細形状・光学ウェイトも一致未確認。全体2版を保持して詳細訂正待ち。独立単体のレビューと全体画像の受入を分離。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

references.acquisitionRoute: Chromeで観察した公開画像URLまたは文書化された画像保存
